newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar, basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel weakened slightly against the dollar and basket of key foreign currencies in quiet trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
A dealer at Bank Hapoalim said the shekel's rate fluctuated between 3.5250 and 3.5450 to the dollar.
"The market was quiet today. That's because the dollar in the world was fairly quiet," the dealer said.

The representative rate for the dollar on Wednesday was fixed at 3.5340 shekels compared with 3.5300 on Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.7628 against 3.7586 on Monday.
The Bank of Israel did not set a representative rate on Tuesday becuase of the Jewish fast day of Tisha B'Av.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 3.0396 shekels per 100 yen compared with 3.0491 on Monday, and against the mark at 1.9152 shekels compared with 1.9025 on Monday.
In late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.5350 shekels.
- Tova Cohen, Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211 x233
